a: I'm a pianist and music director based in Melbourne, Australia, and everything is done online, so I record tracks for singers all over the world. Send your sheet music through the order form and your track is delivered as a download, wherever you are.

q: How long does it take to receive my track?
a: Standard delivery is typically within 3-5 business days. If you need it faster, select 'As soon as humanly possible' (free) to request priority scheduling, or choose the 'Rush Order' add-on for guaranteed 24-hour delivery.

q: Can I request a transposition (different key)?
a: Absolutely! You can specify the original key and your requested key on the order form. I'm happy to provide the track in whatever key suits your voice best.

q: What file format will I receive?
a: All tracks are delivered as high-quality MP3 files (320kbps). If you require a WAV file for a specific performance, just let me know in the special requests.

q: What if I need a small adjustment after delivery?
a: I want you to be 100% happy with your track. Small tweaks to tempo or dynamics after delivery are free: just reply to your delivery email and I'll take care of it. Bigger changes, like a different cut or a new intro or ending, are the Additional Edits add-on (+$5), which you can tick on the order form.

q: Why do some scores cost more?
a: Dense scores by Sondheim, Jason Robert Brown or Adam Guettel take much longer to learn and record accurately because of their intricate harmony and piano writing, so they carry a Complex Score adjustment (+$10).

q: How do I pay for my track?
a: You can pay via Stripe (Credit/Debit Card) directly on the site, or use 'Buy Me a Coffee' or Direct Bank Transfer. Details are provided on your personal track dashboard.

q: Can I get sheet music of my cut?
a: Yes. Add Custom Sheet Music (+$50) to your order and I'll engrave a clean score of your exact cut in Sibelius, with no cut marks, so it's ready for your audition folder.
